fields.label: Source term
fields.summary: The term as it appears in the text you translate. It cannot be blank.

fields.label: Translation
fields.summary: The translation the model must use for that term.

fields.label: Note
fields.summary: Context for the model, for example which sense of the term is meant.

fields.label: Keep as is
fields.summary: Keep the term exactly as written in the source. The Translation box is then disabled and may stay empty.

example.text: Open the Dashboard in LLM Translate to see your history.
example.translation: Abre el tablero de LLM Translate para ver tu historial.

fields.label: Tone
fields.summary: Tone of voice, for example friendly, neutral or authoritative.

fields.label: Formality
fields.summary: Level of formality, for example formal or informal.

fields.label: Audience
fields.summary: Who will read the translation, for example enterprise IT admins.

fields.label: Notes
fields.summary: Free-form instructions for the translator, for example which pronoun to use.
